name: emi-analyzer
description: Analyze PCB layouts for EMI and EMC problems with the EMI Analyzer app on your computer: return paths, plane gaps, decoupling, ESD at connectors, cable budgets, and what changed between versions of a board.

emi_local.title: emi-local path
emi_local.description: Leave empty to use the installed EMI Analyzer app. Set it to an emi-local the plugin would not find on its own, for example a build from source.

app_url.title: EMI Analyzer address
app_url.description: Leave empty to find (or start) the app on this computer. Set it to use one you started yourself, for example http://127.0.0.1:7465.
